floral_infrastructure_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Heavy-duty structural elements including Sunflower mounts, Tulip terminals, Orchid caddies, and Rose-Thorn hooks. Sliced in structural 95A TPU with an expanded 0.30mm horizontal tolerance to compensate for rubber die-swell, ensuring the interchangeable Passion-Flower keyways rotate and lock friction-tight without binding.

sanitary_pouches_soft_tpu_85a.structural_purpose: Flexible wall storage units like the Succulent Wall Pods. Sliced in soft-touch 85A TPU with a 3-wall perimeter shell to optimize flexibility, utilizing the textured PEI plate face to create that premium, velvet-matte satin finish that replicates real brushed ceramics.

meal_prep_containers_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: Hydrophobic food-contact elements including Water-Lily dish racks and Peony school meal containers. Sliced in pure, high-density food-safe Polypropylene (PP) to enforce natural structural elasticity for the living hinges while exploiting PP's low surface energy to bead off water and juice crossovers completely.
